kids-money-shop: Money Shop for Kids: Learn Rupees, Paying and Change
A play shop with rupee notes and coins. Children pay exact prices, give change as the shopkeeper, and fill a basket in their own shop. Free, private, works on phones.
tambola-ticket-generator: Tambola Ticket Generator and Number Caller (Housie)
Make printable tambola tickets, 6 per sheet using every number 1 to 90, and call numbers on screen with a board and optional voice. Free, no sign-up, private.
shadow-explorer-for-kids: Shadow and Sun Explorer for Kids: Move the Sun, See the Shadow
Drag the sun and a person, tree or flagpole to see where the shadow falls and how long it is. Hide the shadow to guess first, then take the quiz. Free, private.
addition-with-carrying-for-kids: Addition with Carrying for Kids: Step by Step
Watch every carry happen in column addition, then try it yourself. Use the examples or your own numbers up to 999. Free, no sign-up.
subtraction-with-borrowing-for-kids: Subtraction with Borrowing for Kids: Step by Step
Watch how borrowing works in column subtraction, even across a zero, then try it yourself. Your own numbers up to 999. Free, no sign-up.
